:::{#exm-deviation-pop-mean}
#### Deviation of a die roll from its mean

A fair die roll $Y$ has $\E{Y} = 3.5$
(computed on the [expectation page](expectation.qmd#exm-linearity-expectation)),
so a roll of $y = 5$ has deviation

$$
\begin{aligned}
\devn(5) &= 5 - 3.5 \\
&= 1.5,
\end{aligned}
$$

and a roll of $y = 2$ has deviation

$$
\begin{aligned}
\devn(2) &= 2 - 3.5 \\
&= -1.5.
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
